shurer-dhara.title: Shurer Dhara
shurer-dhara.tagline: A global digital home for Rabindrasangeet, culture, and community impact.

awakynn.title: Awakynn
awakynn.tagline: A calm, ritual-led digital home for a modern yoga, meditation, and Ayurveda practice.
awakynn.description: For Awakynn, we built a calm, trust-first web experience for a yoga, meditation, and Ayurvedic wellness practice led by instructor Monalisa Manna. The site translates the depth of the practice into transparent offerings, instructor credibility, authentic testimonials, and a connected wellness ecosystem spanning sister brands GrabFabs, Festiq, and Éstrá Ritual.

credits.Scope: UX Direction · Content Architecture · Frontend Build · Offerings & Booking Presentation
credits.Outcome: A ritual-paced digital studio connecting instructor trust, offerings, testimonials, and the wider Awakynn wellness ecosystem

westra.title: Westra Wear
westra.theme: D2C Retail · Live Selling · Social Commerce
westra.description: For Westra Wear, we designed and delivered a complete web experience that merges premium fashion storytelling with practical online buying. The build balances editorial visual language, category-led discovery, and high-intent purchase flows while supporting a social-first live sales model across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

credits.Scope: UX Direction · Frontend Build · Commerce IA · Conversion Copy
credits.Outcome: Unified online shop + live sales funnel for faster product discovery and assisted checkout

kdiae.title: KD Institute of Advance Education
kdiae.tagline: A trust-first admissions platform for a growing education institution.
kdiae.theme: School Admissions · Parent Trust · Institutional Growth

We continue to support the institution with ongoing services, including a custom ERP roadmap and expansion planning for future training centers and ITI colleges.

credits.Scope: UX Strategy · Frontend Development · Admissions Funnel · Content Architecture
